title: Use search values in the address
summary: Search parameters let a page keep small filter choices in the URL.
introduction: Search parameters let a page keep small filter choices in the URL. Your task: Type space and read the topic parameter.
learningObjectives: Type space and read the topic parameter.
Explain the example for use search values in the address

blocks.text: Search parameters let a page keep small filter choices in the URL. A copied address can then describe the same filter.

Use React Router 7 framework mode, the continuation of Remix's framework approach. Save files at the shown app paths. Set ssr:false in react-router.config.ts for this browser-only course. React tooling is required.

blocks.code:
import {useSearchParams} from "react-router";
export default function Filter(){const [params,setParams]=useSearchParams();return <label>Topic <input value={params.get("topic")||""} onChange={e=>setParams({topic:e.target.value})}/></label>;}
blocks.title: Use search values in the address

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `useSearchParams` reads and updates URL search values. Keep private data out of those visible addresses.

blocks.text: Typing changes the topic search value in the address as well as the input.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Do not put private data in a URL. Addresses can be copied, logged and kept in history.
